# Vet Crew Games — free educational games about animals

> Eight browser games about what animals eat, how many are left in the wild,
> which family they belong to, where they live, and which widely repeated claims
> about them are false. Static site, no download and no sign-up; shared rooms
> work with anonymous sign-in, and an account (email or Google) only adds a
> profile and a leaderboard entry. Four interface languages: Ukrainian (bare
> path), English, German, Dutch. Made in support of animal welfare.

## Games

- [What do they eat?](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-feeding/): drag food onto the right animal; wrong food is explained, not just marked wrong.
- [Who is more?](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-population/): compare how many individuals of two species are left in the wild.
- [Fact or Myth?](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-mythbusters/): decide whether a widely repeated claim about an animal is true, then read why.
- [Who is from another family?](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-family/): pick the species that does not belong to the biological family of the others.
- [Where do they live?](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-habitat/): two modes — continents and biomes.
- [Where do they live? — Continents](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-habitat/continents/): which continents the species lives on in the wild.
- [Where do they live? — Biomes](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-habitat/biomes/): which environment you can meet the species in.
- [Find a pair](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/game-memory/): memory game on animal cards, played alone.
- [Quiz](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/quiz/): entry point for the quiz — solo round or a shared room.
- [Quiz — solo round](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/quiz/play/): questions drawn from the games above, one player.
- [Quiz — shared room](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/quiz/online/): several players answer the same questions in one room, joined by a spoken room code.
- [Find a pair — shared](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/pairs/): list of open rooms and quick play for the two-player card game.
- [Find a pair — shared room](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/pairs/online/): the room itself; the board is a move log, so both players always see the same state.
- [Reserve](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/reserve/): pick a biome and run a wildlife reserve — budget, enclosures, staff, disease and poachers over simulated days.
- [Reserve — Temperate forest](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/reserve/forest/): a separate ongoing game in the temperate forest.
- [Reserve — Tundra](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/reserve/tundra/): a separate ongoing game in the tundra.
- [Reserve — Savanna](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/reserve/savanna/): a separate ongoing game in the savanna.
- [Reserve — Rainforest](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/reserve/rainforest/): a separate ongoing game in the rainforest.

## Other pages

- [Account](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/account/): optional profile, people search, follows and leaderboard; games are playable without it.

## Languages

The same pages exist in every language; the home page of each is its entry point.

- [Українська](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/): default language, served from the bare path.
- [English](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/): English interface and game menu.
- [Deutsch](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/de/): deutsche Oberfläche.
- [Nederlands](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/nl/): Nederlandse interface.

## Key features

- Language lives in the address: every page exists as a real prerendered file in each of the four languages, so a link carries the language.
- Four colour themes and two fonts, chosen in the header and kept between visits.
- Full keyboard operation: T theme, L language menu, F fullscreen, Esc close; in the reserve also backtick for pause and 1/2/5 for time speed.
- Accessibility under gates, not by intent: axe over pages and over open overlays, contrast measured across every theme, touch-target size, and no horizontal scrolling down to 320 CSS pixels.

## Technical details

- SvelteKit 2 with Svelte 5 runes; `@sveltejs/adapter-static`; 85 prerendered HTML pages.
- Shared play uses Firebase Realtime Database with an append-only move log, so no player holds authority over the game state.
- Schema.org JSON-LD on every page: `WebApplication` plus `Organization`.
